Source article title: Aisha Wahab
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Aisha Wahab (Democratic Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing California's 14th Congressional District. She assumed office on September 2, 2026. Her current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Wahab (Democratic Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent California's 14th Congressional District. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Wahab (Democratic Party) also ran in a special election to the U.S. House to represent California's 14th Congressional District. She won in the special general election on August 18, 2026.
Wahab (Democratic Party) also ran for re-election to the California State Senate to represent District 10. She did not appear on the ballot for the primary on June 2, 2026.
Wahab completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.

Source article title: Aisha Wahab
Source introduction:
Report an officeholder change
Aisha Wahab (Democratic Party) is a member of the U.S. House, representing California's 14th Congressional District. She assumed office on September 2, 2026. Her current term ends on January 3, 2027.
Wahab (Democratic Party) is running for re-election to the U.S. House to represent California's 14th Congressional District. She is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. She advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Wahab (Democratic Party) also ran in a special election to the U.S. House to represent California's 14th Congressional District. She won in the special general election on August 18, 2026.
Wahab (Democratic Party) also ran for re-election to the California State Senate to represent District 10. She did not appear on the ballot for the primary on June 2, 2026.
Wahab completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
